selection_status: Four prespecified recipes, compared on validation in the MLP study, never on test.
numeric_missing: train median with a fixed indicator for every numeric input
binary_missing: train mode with a fixed missing indicator, keep 0/1 unscaled
categorical_encoding: explicit missing + one-hot, unknown categories map to all-zero within their feature block
target_transform: StandardScaler fit on train only, no clipping or resampling of y

baseline_standard.reason: Reference retaining all 21 safe raw inputs, median, missing indicators, one-hot, StandardScaler.

baseline_minmax.reason: Same inputs as baseline_standard, numeric features scaled to [0, 1] with train min and max, as minmax_scale in the course modules.

log_sensor_caps.reason: Prespecified alternative for long right tails and sensor extremes. Signed log1p preserves valid negative altitude. Caps are exploratory, not verified error labels.

compact_log_sensor_caps.reason: Ablation dropping throughput (rho with cycles 0.984) and peak temperature (rho with ambient 0.920), retaining age + cycles for distinct calendar/use signals. Not a final feature selection.
